title: Open: the Nih-Dairia kit is GPL-3.0 and Stalheart's public repository has no licence; the owner decides before any push
context: Found while revising the boss lab spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-nih-dairia-boss-lab-design.md). The creature comes from the owner's lab-creatures project (/Users/minikai/Dev/Jelly-Baby, f2a4f89), which 'preserves the upstream GPL-3.0 license' of Jelly Baby by scottstts; its kit export carries the LICENSE file. Stalheart's repository (public, kai-denrei/stalheart, source on GitHub and the build on Pages) has no licence file and no licence field in package.json; docs/ASSETS.md licenses only the SentryTowers_A6 assets.
outcome: Porting the kit into src/fx/nih-dairia makes Stalheart's published source a combined work under the GPL's terms. The lab is built on the unpushed branch refactor-run meanwhile; the port's file headers name the origin and the licence and the kit's LICENSE is copied beside the port. Nothing GPL-derived is pushed until the owner chooses: accept GPL-3.0 for Stalheart's published source (add a LICENSE), keep the creature out of the public tree (a private module or a separate repository the page loads), or another arrangement with the upstream author.
evidence: /Users/minikai/Dev/Jelly-Baby/LICENSE (GNU GPL v3), README.md 'Inspiration and license'; the export's LICENSE (35,148 bytes) in dist-exports/nih-dairia-creature-kit.zip
Stalheart: no LICENSE at the root, no license field in package.json (checked 2026-10-08)
